ezra.8.p1.b1.text: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:

ezra.8.p1.b2.text: from the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel; from the descendants of David, Hattush

ezra.8.p1.b3.text: of the descendants of Shecaniah; from the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men; …

ezra.8.p1.b4.text: from the later descendants of Adonikam, … and from the descendants of Bigvai, both Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men.

ezra.8.p2.b1.text: Now I assembled these exiles at the canal that flows to Ahava, and we camped there three days. …

ezra.8.p2.b2.text: … And when I searched among the people and priests, I found no Levites there.

ezra.8.p2.b3.text: Then I summoned the leaders: … And I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, … that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

ezra.8.p2.b4.text: And since the gracious hand of our God was upon us, they brought us Sherebiah—a man of insight … along with his sons and brothers, 18 men; …

ezra.8.p3.b1.text: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God …

ezra.8.p3.b2.text: … and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

ezra.8.p3.b3.text: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, …

ezra.8.p3.b4.text: … “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”

ezra.8.p3.b5.text: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.

ezra.8.p4.b1.text: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,

ezra.8.p4.b2.text: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.

ezra.8.p4.b3.text: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, … 100 talents of gold, 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.

ezra.8.p4.b4.text: “You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. … Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem …”

ezra.8.p4.b5.text: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

ezra.8.p5.b1.text: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, …

ezra.8.p5.b2.text: … and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.

ezra.8.p5.b3.text: So we arrived at Jerusalem and rested there for three days.

ezra.8.p5.b4.text: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and sacred articles into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. … Everything was verified by number and weight, and the total weight was recorded at that time.

ezra.8.p5.b5.text: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: … All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.

ezra.8.p5.b6.text: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates, who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God.
